## What is missing, and for whom

## Why it belongs in a reference application

This repository exists to demonstrate a pattern, not to be a complete
product. The useful question is whether the change teaches something a reader
would otherwise have to work out alone.

## What it would touch

- [ ] Backend API contract
- [ ] A projection or a catalog component
- [ ] The agent's tools or prompt
- [ ] The Flutter client
- [ ] Infrastructure or delivery
- [ ] Documentation only

## Alternatives you considered

Including the one where nothing changes.
